sources.title: parakeet-redux: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Choose parakeet-redux for its multilingual V3-derived tokenizer and language coverage, smaller packed weights, and Photon CPU performance. Choose the MLX V2 conversion when you need an MLX-native workflow on Apple hardware or a command-line path through parakeet-mlx or mlx-audio.
